description: This 3D model preview displays a sleek and modern table lamp. It features a simple, slightly conical lampshade, rendered in a bright white. The most striking element is its base, which is composed of two elegantly curved, intertwining arms that create an abstract, sculptural form before connecting to a flat, circular foot. The entire lamp is presented in a uniform white finish against a neutral gray background, emphasizing its clean lines and contemporary aesthetic. Its design is both functional as a light source and decorative as a piece of art.
